# Don Colchón

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mexican mattress retailer with physical branches and an online store on Shopify. Its shipping page states free shipping to any state of Mexico for online purchases, direct delivery in cities with its own coverage, and carrier-branch pickup (ocurre) elsewhere.
